component.name: dYT
component.summary: Download YouTube videos, audio or exact clips

description.p: dYT downloads from YouTube with a native engine: many connections at once for full speed, automatic recovery from dropped connections and expired links, and clips that fetch only the part you pick and cut it on the exact timestamp.

ul.li: Video and audio, video only, or audio only, at the quality you choose
Clips: mark a start, play, stop to mark the end, or drag both points
Raw streams, untouched, when you want YouTube's original files
History of everything you opened, one click to open it again
Follows the system's light or dark style as it changes
